claims.citation: New York Herald, 21 August 1866, p. 5, col. 6
New York Herald, 7 August 1866, p. 2, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Boston (Br), Brooks, Liverpool, July 25,
and Queenstown 26th, with mdse and 560[?] passengers, to John
G Dale. July 26, off Mine Head, passed steamship Scotland,
bound up Channel; off Daunt's Rock, steamship City of
Manchester, bound in; off Slage[?] Rocks, steamship Cuba,
bound up Channel; Aug 1, lat 48[?] 15, lon 43[?], steamship City of
Limerick, bound E.

Steamship Tripoli, Harrison, Liverpool, July 31, via Queenstown
1st inst., with mdse. and 481 pass. to E. Cunard. Aug. 1, 5 p. m.,
passed steamship City of Cork bound up channel. 4th inst., lat. 50 48,
long. 21 11, steamship City of Limerick bound E; 5th, lat. 50 38, long.
27 17, an Inman steamer bound E.
